description: Source code for the TaskMetrics class in Apache Spark, which tracks various execution metrics during task execution, including accumulator management, input/output metrics, and shuffle metrics.

classes.name: TaskMetrics
classes.description: Tracks execution metrics for a Spark task, manages internal and external accumulators, and provides methods for metric collection and merging.

methods.name: executorDeserializeTime
methods.description: Returns the total executor deserialize time for the task.

methods.name: executorDeserializeCpuTime
methods.description: Returns the CPU time spent deserializing the task.

methods.name: executorRunTime
methods.description: Returns the total executor run time for the task.

methods.name: executorCpuTime
methods.description: Returns the CPU time spent executing the task.

methods.name: resultSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the task result in bytes.

methods.name: jvmGCTime
methods.description: Returns the JVM garbage collection time during task execution.

methods.name: resultSerializationTime
methods.description: Returns the time spent serializing the task result.

methods.name: memoryBytesSpilled
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes spilled in memory.

methods.name: diskBytesSpilled
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes spilled to disk.

methods.name: peakExecutionMemory
methods.description: Returns the peak execution memory used during the task.

methods.name: peakOnHeapExecutionMemory
methods.description: Returns the peak on-heap execution memory.

methods.name: peakOffHeapExecutionMemory
methods.description: Returns the peak off-heap execution memory.

methods.name: updatedBlockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the storage statuses of blocks updated during the task.
